Gabion & wire — 01 / 07

Gabion mesh

FR / RW trade terms: FR: Cages de gabion, matelas Reno · RW: Gabiyo (uruzitiro rw’amabuye)

Heavy-duty woven and welded gabion baskets and mattresses for retaining walls, slope stabilisation and erosion control.

Quote this product All products
  • Hillside retaining walls & terracing
  • Road embankment & culvert protection
  • Riverbank & channel erosion control
  • Architectural landscape walls

Overview

We supply double-twisted hexagonal woven and welded gabion baskets and mattresses engineered for Rwanda’s hillside terrain, road corridors and riverbanks. Available in heavy galvanised and PVC-coated finishes with matching selvedge and lacing wire. Share your project drawings, box dimensions and quantity to receive a fast, itemised quotation.

Typical specifications & options

Standard box sizes
2m × 1m × 1m · 1.5m × 1m × 1m · 3m × 1m × 1m · 2m × 1m × 0.5m
Mattress sizes
3m × 2m × 0.3m · 6m × 2m × 0.3m (internal diaphragms at 1m centres)
Mesh aperture
60 × 80 mm · 80 × 100 mm · 100 × 120 mm double-twisted hexagonal
Wire & coating
2.7 mm – 3.9 mm mesh/selvedge wire; heavy zinc galvanised or grey/green PVC coated

Specifications above reflect typical industry sizes and options in this category. Contact our Kigali desk to confirm current stock and exact grades for your order.
